security_system.prompt: Create a clean high-resolution OEM automotive accessory product photograph based on this period Subaru Impreza security-system upgrade kit reference. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Arrange the complete functional kit neatly on a seamless pale gray studio background: compact black security control module on a silver mounting bracket, black round security horn with long dark metal bracket, two small black relays on a small silver bracket, coiled black extension wiring harness with period-correct white multi-pin connectors, small silver mounting hardware, and two small blue Subaru security window decals. Remove the paper instruction sheet and all packaging. Preserve the early-2000s component designs; do not modernize the electronics or add a remote-start fob. Use soft overhead product lighting, crisp focus, realistic plastics, metal and wiring, subtle contact shadows. Any tiny regulatory or part-label text on components should be non-readable rather than invented. No large text, watermark, hands, car, box, or decorative branding.
security_system.limitations: Component geometry is based on a period H7110SS100 Impreza kit; the 2005 H7110SS300/H7110SS400 application is independently documented, but this image does not claim exact readable part labels.
